title: Sparkly aeroplane
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Sparkles around the plane -->
  <g fill="#FFF176">
    <!-- top left sparkle -->
    <polygon points="18,18 20,23 25,25 20,27 18,32 16,27 11,25 16,23"/>
    <!-- top right sparkle -->
    <polygon points="82,15 84,20 89,22 84,24 82,29 80,24 75,22 80,20"/>
    <!-- bottom left sparkle -->
    <polygon points="12,72 14,76 18,78 14,80 12,84 10,80 6,78 10,76"/>
    <!-- small sparkle top center -->
    <polygon points="50,8 51.5,12 55.5,13.5 51.5,15 50,19 48.5,15 44.5,13.5 48.5,12"/>
    <!-- bottom right sparkle -->
    <polygon points="86,68 88,73 93,75 88,77 86,82 84,77 79,75 84,73"/>
    <!-- tiny sparkle left -->
    <polygon points="8,45 9.5,48.5 13,50 9.5,51.5 8,55 6.5,51.5 3,50 6.5,48.5"/>
    <!-- tiny sparkle right -->
    <polygon points="92,38 93.5,41.5 97,43 93.5,44.5 92,48 90.5,44.5 87,43 90.5,41.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Airplane body - main fuselage -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="30" ry="8" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <!-- Fuselage lighter highlight stripe -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="28" ry="4" fill="#81D4FA"/>

  <!-- Nose cone -->
  <path d="M78,52 Q88,52 88,50 Q88,48 78,48 Z" fill="#29B6F6"/>

  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <path d="M20,52 L14,34 L22,34 L28,50 Z" fill="#0288D1"/>
  <path d="M21,50 L17,36 L22,36 L26,50 Z" fill="#4FC3F7"/>

  <!-- Horizontal tail stabilizer -->
  <path d="M20,52 L10,44 L20,46 Z" fill="#0288D1"/>
  <path d="M20,52 L10,60 L20,55 Z" fill="#0288D1"/>

  <!-- Main wing (upper) -->
  <path d="M40,48 L30,30 L48,30 L58,46 Z" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <path d="M42,47 L34,33 L47,33 L54,45 Z" fill="#FFD54F"/>

  <!-- Main wing (lower) -->
  <path d="M40,52 L30,70 L48,70 L58,54 Z" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <path d="M42,53 L34,67 L47,67 L54,55 Z" fill="#FFD54F"/>

  <!-- Cockpit windows -->
  <path d="M70,48 Q76,48 78,50 Q76,50 70,50 Z" fill="#B3E5FC"/>
  <path d="M64,48 Q68,47 70,48 Q68,49 64,49 Z" fill="#E1F5FE"/>

  <!-- Row of windows on fuselage -->
  <circle cx="56" cy="51" r="2" fill="#E1F5FE"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="51" r="2" fill="#E1F5FE"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="51" r="2" fill="#E1F5FE"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="51" r="2" fill="#E1F5FE"/>

  <!-- Propeller at nose -->
  <ellipse cx="88" cy="50" rx="2" ry="8" fill="#F44336"/>
  <ellipse cx="88" cy="50" rx="1" ry="3" fill="#FFCDD2"/>

  <!-- Engine detail under wing -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="62" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#0288D1"/>
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="62" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
</svg>
